project: Anarvā — Skirmish AI for Beyond All Reason (BARb/CircuitAI core + own AngelScript brain/configs)

goal.statement: 1 Anarva must be able to beat 6 BARb (hard) opponents on all types of maps
goal.success_metric: 1v6 vs BARb:hard: win (or decisive points win at 40 min) on every map type, repeated across factions

milestones.desc: 1v1 vs BARb hard: >= 2:1 win ratio across all map types
1v2 vs BARb hard: win majority on all map types

features.name: Army quota scaling
features.desc: attack quota = 30%->55% of ground army power; raid gather = max(3 raiders, 40% raider pool)

features.name: Broken-squad recall
features.desc: abort raid/attack squads below 40% of peak power -> survivors regroup

features.name: Eco recycling
features.desc: reclaim solar/wind/tidal/adv-solar once fusion-tier carries; fusions once 2+ AFUS carry; T1 makers once 4+ T2 makers; blocks rebuild via maxThisUnit=0, restores on energy collapse

features.name: Obsolete T1 unit salvage
features.desc: after 22 min with adv factory and m_inc>=30: take idle T1 unit near base out of control and reclaim

features.name: Jammer intel
features.desc: enemy jammer role tagging, phantom threat kernel on seen jammers, loss heatmap -> Dragon's Eyes, scout quota + air scouts on alert

features.name: Strategic planner
features.desc: anti-nuke (enemy silo or rich), Juno (jammer alert), EMP/tac launcher forward, nuke under AMD, shields over most valuable infra

features.name: Factory composition tuning from pro replays
1vN defensive play (chokes, porc where it pays)

tools.batch.py: parallel batch + scoreboard by map type
tools.run_replay.py: headless replay playback with analyzer widget
tools.fetch_replays.py: download high-skill public replays (api.bar-rts.com + OVH storage)
tools.patch_jammer_roles.py: tag jammer UnitDefs with enemy role

experiments.desc: first Anarva build vs BARb hard, Avalanche
experiments.result: behind at 45m; revealed army power undercount and reclaim-as-loss heat bug (both fixed)
ARTY 109, DEFEND 107, ATTACK 0-6, RAID 3-4: armies almost never launch; factory/eco split starves army

experiments.desc: baseline 12 games 1v1 vs BARb hard, all map types

findings: BARb spends ~57-66% of metal on mobile-constructor (static) tasks; army stays tiny (army_m ~6k vs static ~50k at 40 min).
Raid squads only end when their leader dies -> survivors raid alone (the 'one by one' trickle).
Attack squads launch only at quota.attack (60 power) and abort below the quota they were created with.
BARb never builds Juno, anti-nuke, EMP/tac launcher, nukes, shields or walls (not in any build list it reaches).
Core reclaims old energy only when a new generator finishes and only within 1000 elmos of base.
Threat ranges only project for armed units, so jammer phantom threat works through enemy group influence, not the threat map.
GetFightType() is only on IFighterTask (needs cast<IFighterTask>).
Lobby hides non-whitelisted AIs: devmode.txt + Settings>Developer>untick simple AI list. Only the bot's owner needs Anarva installed.
